title: Rename field
skill: Say what must keep working after a rename

good: Rename the User field user_name to username in accounts/models.py, accounts/store.py, accounts/report.py, tests/test_accounts.py and README.md (example and export format; the README must not mention user_name). Also rename the find_user parameter to username. dump_users writes the key "username" only. load_users must still accept old records with "user_name": use record.get("username", record.get("user_name")), so username wins when both exist; if neither exists, raise ValueError("username is required"). The old name may stay only in that loader line. Then run: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
